update.data:
Om Namo Venkatesaya
 
The Online Quota of General Srivari Seva for Tirumala and Tirupati, Navaneeta Seva, Parakamani Seva for the month of -November 2026 will be released at 3 PM on 28.9.2026.
 
**Reporting Days:**

General Sevaks have to report on the same day of their Seva booking date for both Tirupati and Tirumala.
 
Parakamani Sevaks have to report one day before  their seva booking date  in Tirumala between 2 pm and 4 pm.
 
**Note:**

Profile creation is also available for Sevaks.

Om Namo Venkatesaya
 
The Online Quota of General Srivari Seva for Local SV Temples of 
Hyderabad,
Bhuvaneswar,
Visakhapatnam,
Bengaluru and
Vontimitta for November 2026 will be released at 4 PM on 28.09.2026.
 
**Note:**
Only LOCALS of the above temples have to apply.
 
NO Accommodation/Transport will be provided by TTD.
 
**Reporting Days:**
General Srivari Sevaks have to report on the same day of their Seva booking date in the respected temple premises to concern reporting in-charges.

TTD - Local Temples Seva Quota for October-2026 will be available for booking w.e.f 25.09.2026 at 10:00 AM. Please [Click Here](/arjitha-seva/slot-booking?section=pilgrim-details&flowIdentifier=arjitha-seva&templeName=Sri%20Padmavathi%20Ammavari%20Temple&sevaName=All)
